Section 'A'
Multiple choice questions.
Circle the correct alternative of the following questions.
1. Which is the main ore of iron?
i) Bauxite ii) Hematite iii) Argentite iv) Pyrite
Ans:- ii) Hematite
2. Which metal is found in pure state in nature?
i) Aluminum ii) iron
iii) Copper
iv) Gold
Ans:- iv) Gold
3. Which is the primary step of purifying metal?
i) Smelting ii) Roasting
iii) Concentration
iv) Grinding
Ans:- iv) Grinding
4. Which of the following ore is oxidsed by roasting method?
i) Hematite ii) Bauxite iii) Siderite iv) Cuprite
Ans:- iii) Siderite
5. In which process is smelting included?
i) Grinding ii) Refining
iii) Oxidation iv) Reduction
Ans:- iv) Reduction
6. How much percentage of silver is present in the argentite ore?
iii) 87%
Ans:- iii) 87%
7. In which step of metallurgy, gangue is removed?
i) Grinding ii) Concentration
iii) Roasting
iv) Smelting
Ans:- ii) Concentration
8. In which step of metallurgy, impurities are separated in the form of slug?
i) Smelting ii) Electro-refining iii) Roasting
iv) Concentration
Ans:- i) Smelting
Section 'B'
Very short answer type questions.
1. Which metal is obtained from chalcopyrite?
Ans:- Copper is obtained from chalcopyrite.
2. Write two major ores of iron.
Ans:- Haematite and magnetite are the two major ores of iron.
3. Name a metal obtained from argentite.
Ans:- Silver is obtained from argentite.
4. Write the name of any two ore of silver.
Ans:- Argentite and horn silver are two ores of silver.
5. Write the name of any two ores of Aluminium.
Ans:- Bauxite and cryolite are two ores of aluminium.
6. How much percentage of iron is found in haematite ore ?
Ans:- Haematite contains about 70% of iron.
7. What is an ore?
Ans:- An ore is a naturally occurring mineral from which a metal can be extracted economically.
8. Why is haematite called an ore?
Ans:- Haematite is called an ore because iron can be extracted from it profitably.
9. Define smelting.
Ans:- Smelting is the process of extracting metal from its ore by heating it with a reducing agent.
10. What is meant by calcination of ore?
Ans:- Calcination is the process of heating an ore in the absence or limited supply of air to remove volatile impurities.
11. Which element is used for the reduction of zinc oxide?
Ans:- Carbon is used for the reduction of zinc oxide.
12. What is electro-refining?
Ans:- Electro-refining is the process of purifying a metal by using electricity.
